messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: tx-gpu-pool-3 at 98% util, queue ~420 — autoscaler unable to provision new nodes, HPA metrics stale :rotating_light:

alex: paging @sre-team @eng-ml — Im on it, starting diagnostics.

morgan: seeing prometheus-adapter errors: repeated timeouts querying Prometheus + a handful of 429s. HPA reads returning 'no metrics'.

sam: large burst of batch-infer jobs (internal-rerank) started ~09:12UTC. Any deploys around then?

deploy-bot: deploy finished by jamie at 2026-03-15T09:12:03Z — batch-worker v2.7.4 rolled.

morgan: correlation noted, but adapter behavior is primary blocker — HPA desired went from 6 -> 12 but actual stayed at 6 due to cloud scale limits + missing metrics.

tasha: CS reporting multiple customers with high p95 on embeddings, some hitting retries/timeouts. No elevated error rate yet but bad latency.

alex: running quick checks:
```
kubectl get hpa -n inference tx-gpu-pool-hpa -o wide
kubectl -n kube-system logs prometheus-adapter-5f9b -c adapter --tail=200
curl -sS http://prometheus:9090/api/v1/query?query=up
```

morgan: adapter log excerpt: "query Prometheus: context deadline exceeded" then "rate limit exceeded (429)". Also seeing stale custom metric objects for a few mins.

sam: redis queue snapshot: pending 1800, processing 330. App-level throttles in place but backlog climbing.

alex: mitigation options: 1) route non-critical batch jobs to tx-gpu-fallback; 2) temporarily increase per-pod concurrency; 3) manual node add via cloud console & open support ticket.

morgan: applying route tag to internal-rerank now (route=fallback).

morgan: route switch applied. Observing queue drop beginning.

sam: deploying config change to reduce batch size and memory per job — will rollout to reduce pressure on GPU memory and pods.

alex: opening cloud ticket for emergency capacity: asking for +6 GPUs in r3 family for RW-Prod. Ticket CS-41237 created.

cloud-support-bot: CS-41237 received, working with quota team, EST ~45 minutes for allocation.

morgan: restarted prometheus-adapter pod to flush stuck queries. After restart adapter reports healthy but custom.metrics API still returning intermittent 404s.

sam: after route/fix, queue fell from 1800 -> 1100 in 10m, latency improving ~25%.

tasha: posting initial customer notice to affected accounts; telling them were mitigating and will send follow-up in 30-60m.

alex: manual node add succeeded — launched 4 r3-gpu-xlarge nodes, theyre joining cluster now.

deploy-bot: cluster autoscaler detected new nodes at 2026-03-15T09:38:17Z.

morgan: HPA now sees metrics again; desired replicas moving to 12, control loop scaling up replicas. Events: "ScalingReplicaSet tx-gpu-deploy -> 12 replicas".

sam: combined effects (route, smaller batch, extra nodes) pushed pending queue 1100 -> 280 over 20m, p95 trending down toward normal.

alex: recommendation: do not rollback v2.7.4 yet — keep batch-size change in place and monitor 1h. Rollback would be noisy; we should instead add safety controls.

morgan: drafting incident summary: impact = increased latency and queueing for embeddings/batch infer; some enterprise customers experienced timeouts. probable cause = prometheus-adapter query timeouts + cloud scale limit hit prevented autoscaler scale. contributing = traffic surge coincident with batch-worker rollout.

sam: action items Ill own: add adapter retry/backoff, extend adapter timeouts, add fallback HPA metric based on pod cpu and queue_length. Will open PR today.

alex: post-incident runbook items: auto-route non-critical batch to fallback pool when adapter returns errors; add alert for adapter query latency > 10s; review cloud account scale limits and apply pre-approved emergency capacity.

morgan: uploading logs and timeline to /mnt/incidents/1835556666/logs.tar.gz (link redacted). Will create postmortem doc and link back here.

tasha: CS update sent to affected customers; provided mitigation summary and next steps.

alex: handing off to night oncall (jamie) for 1h monitoring. Status: mitigated but watch queue and cloud ticket CS-41237 until quota confirmed.

jamie: ack — monitoring window 1h. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: incident marked MITIGATED by on-call at 2026-03-15T10:05:22Z. Follow-up required: postmortem, runbook updates, cloud quota confirmation.

morgan: will finalize postmortem and assign owners for follow-ups. Closing thread for now, will update with postmortem link when ready.
